ITEM 1 | Golden-brown waffle-style pieces with a grid pattern of square pockets, crisp edges and lightly browned surface, three or four overlapping pieces covering roughly 40% of the plate, about 1.5 cm thick, sitting at the lower right and center of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Crumbly, granular mixture with yellow-orange and tan clumps, some bits darker and speckled with green flecks, slightly moist with no pooled liquid, piled in an irregular mound about 8 cm across and 2 cm high on top of and beside the waffles, covering roughly 20% of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Small scattered green-and-yellow bits with a wilted, leafy texture, a few strands lying along the edge of the mixture and under the waffle, covering under 3% of the plate | 5
